title: Luxnet posts record 3Q profit as capacity expansion fuels growth
content: Optical communications maker Luxnet reported a September 2026 net profit attributable to parent-company owners of NT$103 million (US$3.21 million), up 110.2% year-over-year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.72. September EPS exceeded half of the second-quarter 2026 EPS of NT$1.29, signaling strong momentum in the second half of the year.

title: TSMC bars capacity resale, aims to leave no AI money on the table
content: TSMC will not let customers sublease or auction off their wafer capacity allocations, chairman C.C. Wei said during the company's October 15 earnings call. With AI chip demand still far outstripping supply, Wei said TSMC intends to leave no food on the table, making as much as it can, as fast as it can.

title: TSMC investor conference: TSMC lifts 2026 revenue growth forecast to 44%, 2nm expansion, new 3nm fab
content: TSMC Chairman and CEO C.C. Wei announced that, driven by relentless AI momentum and strong demand for advanced process technologies, the company has raised its full-year 2026 US dollar revenue growth guidance to approximately 44%. AI and leading-edge nodes continue to serve as the core growth pillars for the foundry's operations.

title: OpenAI pledges not to use Apple secrets, accuses ex-employee of taking files
content: Apple's trade-secret lawsuit against OpenAI went to a hearing, where OpenAI pledged not to use confidential information that Apple claims was stolen. OpenAI also accused a former employee of taking more than 100 documents related to unreleased products when joining Apple.

title: EU seeks China deal to lift ASML supplier sanctions amid rare-earth crisis
content: The European Union (EU) is negotiating with China to lift sanctions on Sindlhauser Materials GmbH, a small German business that is part of ASML's supply chain, according to people familiar with the matter. In exchange, the EU would remove trade restrictions on a Chinese company previously accused of assisting Russia's war against Ukraine.

title: Aurotek posts record 3Q26 revenue, up 58% on automation demand
content: Aurotek Corp. reported record consolidated revenue of NT$1.113 billion (US$34.7 million) in the third quarter of 2026, up 57.93% from a year earlier. Orders from semiconductor, high-end artificial intelligence (AI) server and electronics manufacturing customers drove demand for the company's automation equipment and subsystems.

title: FIC Group opens Malaysia plant as optical module capacity targets 18 SMT lines
content: FIC Group opened its PRO3C (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. manufacturing facility in Johor, Malaysia, on October 15, expanding its optical communications production footprint in Southeast Asia. The Johor Bahru site is designed to support global customers with 800G, 1.6T, 3.2T and 6.4T optical communication modules as demand grows across artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, data centers and semiconductor applications.

title: AI server tracker: AIC accelerates as Taiwan's connector and chassis suppliers post uneven growth
content: Taiwan's connector and server-chassis suppliers posted broadly higher September revenue, although their growth trajectories differed. Seven of eight tracked companies recorded annual gains for both September and January–September 2026. BizLink, AIC and Chenbro had already exceeded their full-year 2025 revenue, while Argosy remained below last year's levels.

title: TSMC CEO says profitability has no ceiling, plans High-NA EUV adoption in 2030
content: TSMC chairman and CEO C.C. Wei said on October 15 that the chipmaker sees no ceiling on its profitability as demand for AI accelerators continues to outpace supply. Wei also said AI-related growth could exceed the company's long-term forecast and outlined plans to adopt high-numerical-aperture extreme ultraviolet (High-NA EUV) lithography in 2030.

title: SK Hynix reportedly ties US NAND fab plan to approval for chip equipment exports to China
content: SK Hynix is seeking US approval to ship additional American chipmaking equipment to its NAND flash facility in Dalian, China, linking the request to a potential investment in a new US factory, Reuters reported on October 15, citing two people familiar with the matter.

title: AI server tracker: Taiwanese ODM/EMS players post NT$2.18T in September 2026, up 56% YoY
content: Six Taiwanese server and networking contract manufacturers booked combined revenue of NT$2.18 trillion (US$67.3 billion) in September 2026, up 55.9% year-over-year and 4.9% month-over-month, as demand for AI servers stayed strong. Nine-month revenue of NT$15.5 trillion already exceeds the group's full-year 2025 total of NT$14.3 trillion.

title: Applied Materials CEO says agentic AI drives wafer demand
content: Applied Materials CEO Gary Dickerson said customer demand to produce more good dies per wafer and rapidly expand wafer output has reached levels unprecedented in his career, driven by the rise of AI computing. Speaking at a global investor conference, he said the company expects revenue from related businesses to grow by more than 20% over the next several years.

title: India's RRP Electronics opens advanced wafer-level packaging facility in Navi Mumbai
content: India's RRP Electronics has inaugurated an Advanced Wafer-Level Packaging (AWLP) facility at its semiconductor unit in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, adding SIM and eSIM module production and specialized testing to its outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) operations. The facility opened on October 12, 2026, according to Dalal Street Investment Journal.

title: TSMC breaks silence on Musk's Terafab: Talks underway, but fab control non-negotiable
content: TSMC has confirmed that it is in discussions with Elon Musk's Terafab initiative over potential semiconductor manufacturing cooperation, marking the first public acknowledgment of talks between the two sides.

title: TSMC eyes US$54.3bn in 4Q26 revenue, but 2nm ramp and overseas fabs pressure margins
content: TSMC expects fourth-quarter 2026 revenue to reach US$52.3 billion to US$54.3 billion, potentially rising as much as 61% year-over-year, with sustained demand for advanced semiconductor manufacturing and accelerating 2nm production supporting its year-end outlook.

title: China's AMEC targets 60% of high-end chip equipment market with US$1.94 billion R&D plan
content: Chinese semiconductor equipment maker AMEC plans to develop 102 new equipment models over the next three to five years, backed by nearly CNY13 billion (≈ US$1.94 billion) in research and development investment. The expansion will extend its portfolio beyond plasma etching into thin-film deposition, advanced packaging, inspection and other semiconductor manufacturing processes.
